note: The high bit of the second byte chooses direct buffer input when clear.
The attacker-controlled payload is attached as a PNG buffer, which is the admission path for this candidate.
Buffer mode allows the library to read directly from the provided PNG bytes without the stream callback layer.
The decoded-size query enters the ancillary parser after the valid PNG header and IDAT are supplied.
Decode follows the same path to reach the image-data sink once admission succeeds.
